# The sitemap is generated by the SSR server from route data

**Status:** Accepted
**Area:** [ssr-seo-and-prerender](../../area/ssr-seo-and-prerender.md)

## Context

The SEO landing pages (`/hostels/:place`, `/hostels/:place/:gender`, campus pages) and blog articles
come from code lists (`PLACES`, `GENDER_SEGMENTS`, `UNIVERSITIES`, `BLOG_POSTS`). The site serves
several languages and states `hreflang` in each page head.

## Decision

`server.ts` answers `GET /sitemap.xml` itself, before `express.static`, with
`renderSitemap(SITE_ORIGIN, sitemapPaths())`, cached for one hour. `sitemapPaths()` builds the list
from the same data the routes read. Each path is prefixed with every `INDEXED_LOCALE_CODES` language,
and each `<url>` repeats the full `hreflang` set from `localeAlternates`, the same function `Seo` uses
for the head.

## Alternatives rejected

- **A committed static sitemap file.** It goes stale the first time someone adds a place in a hurry.
- **Unprefixed URLs.** They only redirect. Listing them spends crawl budget on 302s and names the wrong
  address.
- **Every routable locale.** A locale that falls back to English is the English page at another
  address, so a search engine would see duplicates. Only `translated: true` locales are listed.
- **`lastmod`, `changefreq`, `priority`.** Google ignores the last two. A build-time `lastmod` would
  claim every page changed on every deploy, which teaches Google to ignore it.
- **`/search/*` and `/hostel/:id`.** Search URLs are canonicalised or `noindex`. Listing ids are opaque
  and change often, so the landing pages are what ranks.

## Consequences

- Adding to `PLACES`, `UNIVERSITIES` or `BLOG_POSTS` adds sitemap entries automatically. A new static
  page has to be added to `STATIC_PATHS` by hand, and its route needs `data: { head: 'index' }`.
  `app.routes.spec.ts` fails when the two disagree (see
  [route-level head ownership](./route-level-head-ownership.md)). `/pricing` and `/credits` were
  missing until PR #104.
- A new place needs a social card, or `apps/web/src/app/core/social-image.spec.ts` fails.
- `/sitemap.xml` exists only on the SSR server, not in the `build-mobile` output or `serve-static`.
